mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5%, accommodative monetary policy reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as investors shift to risk assets.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL increases and INDPRO decreases indicate supply-side inflation shocks, compressing corporate margins and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and INDPRO falls, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, HOUST > 1200 thousand and RSAFS > 450000 million signal robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as economic momentum accelerates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods with HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 450000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days as liquidity conditions deteriorate.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 1 month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous UNRATE increases and PAYEMS declines indicate labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as economic growth risks rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly HOUST decline below 1100 thousand signals weakening housing demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as consumer confidence erodes.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1100 thousand, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained INDPRO above 105.0 indicates strong industrial output, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
